description: Liste des actions prises par les ministères dans le cadre des feuilles de routes ministérielles is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Etalab. On 27 April 2021, the Prime Minister renewed the Government’s ambition for the exploitation, openness and circulation of data, algorithms and public source codes by sending a dedicated circular to all ministers and prefects of the region, under the leadership of the Minister of Transformation and Public Service. Coverage: Etalab. The portal shows the English title as "List of actions taken by ministries in the framework of departmental roadmaps" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Etalab. Its keywords include opendata, donnees, algorithme, circulation, ouverture, algorithmes-publics. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV, XLSX. The listing shows 2022-07-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
